consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance of the 1988-06-17 show at The Met Center is solid, particularly noting the significance of the first performance of 'Victim or the Crime.' While the audio quality is a common point of contention, many reviewers appreciate the energy and some standout moments in the setlist.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.1 for 11 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: The mixed sentiment reflects the divide between fans who enjoyed the performance and those frustrated by the audio quality.
